elements.element: Services performed in a professional manner
elements.evidence: Clause addresses only that "each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation"; no services performance standard anywhere in the edit.

elements.element: Services performed in a workmanlike manner
elements.evidence: No "workmanlike" standard appears: "For ninety (90) days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation".
"will materially conform to its documentation" — conformance is qualified by "materially", short of the preferred conformance position.
"For ninety (90) days after delivery" — no 12-month software period stated.

elements.element: 90-day warranty period for services, measured from performance/completion
elements.evidence: Period runs "after delivery" of a Deliverable; no services warranty or performance-based measurement.
"Vendor has no correction or refund obligation" after the period; no affirmative repair remedy is granted.
No replacement remedy appears in the revised text.
"after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation" implies correction/refund obligations during the period.
No compliance-with-laws language in the clause as redlined.
No malicious code warranty in the clause as redlined.
The 90 days applies to "each Deliverable" (reports, configurations, work product), not to software; no software warranty period is stated.
No services warranty of any duration: only "each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation".
Only "correction or refund" is implied; no replacement remedy is expressed.

offending_extra_words: without limiting any other warranty, service level, indemnity, or remedy in this Agreement
reasons: Locked target is preferred, but the redline only lengthens the Deliverable conformance window; it adds none of the preferred elements — professional and workmanlike services, software conformance for 12 months, a 90-day services warranty, repair and replacement remedies, compliance with laws, or no malicious code.
Conformance remains qualified as "materially conform", which the preferred position (documentation conformance) does not permit.
Fallback also fails: no software-specific 90-day period, no 30-day services warranty, and no replacement remedy.

Minimality fails: changing "fifteen" to "ninety (90)" sufficed, yet the operation rewrote the sentence and appended a non-limitation carve-out ("under this Section 19.2, without limiting any other warranty, service level, indemnity, or remedy in this Agreement"), expanding 23 words to 41 (ratio 1.78).
Intent is preserved — the untouched cut-off mechanic and other sections remain effective and no undefined term is introduced.
